attributes.organization_short_description: Our Mission\\To be America's neighborhood hardware and garden store focused on paint, repair, and the backyard.\\Our Story\\1931 was a year of hard times for farmers in San José, California. Two years of drought and crop failures plus the Great Depression brought plenty of economic woe. Thirty farmers, mostly prune growers, considered buying their farm supplies as a cooperative. Each farmer put up $30 and Orchard Supply was born.\\Business grew and Orchard Supply moved to a larger location on 44 Vine Street. In addition to farm supplies, the new store location brought in hardware, gardening supplies, housewares and homewares. Again, business flourished and in 1946, a new store was built at 720 West San Carlos Street. The newest location featured a rail-served warehouse and 26,000 square feet of retail space. By this time the purchasing cooperative had almost 2,000 members and Orchard Supply was recognized as a leading hardware store in San José.\\In 1962, Albert B. Smith became president of Orchard Supply Hardware. Under his direction Orchard Supply Hardware grew with branch stores being established throughout the county. In 1973, the Capitola store became the first out-of-county location. In the mid 1970's, a nineteen acre warehouse and office complex in San José was purchased from Sunsweet Growers to serve as a distribution center for all Orchard stores. Fondly called the 'Prune Palace,' it served Orchard Supply Hardware well up to 1992, when a new distribution center was opened in the central California community of Tracy.\\The concepts that made Orchard Supply Hardware a successful hardware retailer continue. With over 45,000 items, modern, easy-to-shop stores and acclaimed customer service, Orchard Supply Hardware maintains the same simple retail philosophy developed long ago, 'Take good care of our customers and they will take good care of you.'

attributes.organization_short_description: Interconnect Solutions Limited is an industry leader, globally renowned for providing reliable, high-performance network solutions catering to rapidly evolving connectivity needs of corporations. We are a leading supplier/manufacturer of products and solutions in the field of network infrastructure, catering to copper, fibre and RF/wireless networks. As a comprehensive provider of network infrastructure products, we also cater to the network's power back up and bespoke component needs. With a vision of becoming the leading vendor of choice for products used in telecom, datacom and enterprise networks, we progressively work towards innovating and providing world-class products that allow our customers' business to surpass their organization's goals. \\Measuring our success through consistent satisfaction of our customers, stakeholders and employees, Interconnect Solutions has seen growth since 2005. We have an international clientele through channel partners in Europe, Middle East, Africa and South Asia. Headquartered in the UK, we offer seamless network capability on international standards, with services ensured to optimise business performance on the highest operational excellence available in market. \\We provide solutions that give a critical strategic edge to help your business grow and ensure that your clients remain connected with the world. Our robust, scalable, industry compliant and dependable leading-edge products help the industry's evolving needs. \\By working alongside our clients, we customise solutions to particular needs and provide full support for each phase of a project's life cycle.

attributes.organization_short_description: De bouwgroep Willy Naessens is een onderneming gespecialiseerd in de bouw van KMO-gebouwen, logistieke gebouwen, distributiecentra, kantoren, commerciële ruimtes, garages, landbouwgebouwen en zwembaden.\ \In globo kan gesteld worden dat de bouwgroep Willy Naessens model staat voor het perfecte bouwsysteem, zowel structureel als esthetisch en dit voor bijna elke toepassing. Door zijn totale verticale integratie heeft de bouwgroep Willy Naessens alles in eigen beheer, van studiedienst en productie tot eigen transport en montage, hetgeen zich weerspiegelt in de reeds meer dan 7000 realisaties.\ \Naast onze bouw- en productiebedrijven doen wij met de Willy Naessens Group ook aan diversificatie van onze activiteiten. Zo behoren ook volgende firma's tot de Willy Naessens Group: Franky Fresh Food en Blancke Distributie, de marktleider in België als distributeur van bereide vleeswaren en anderzijds de firma's Frank Delmote, Salami Peeters en Blancke Productie, producenten van verschillende vleeswaren, waaronder spek, hesp, paté en salami.
